title: Filler: Hinata's Gentle Fist
later: I-it can wait... You look busy. Maybe later?

offer.speaker: hinata
offer.text: U-um... could you train with me? Father says my Gentle Fist is too soft...

offer.speaker: hinata
offer.text: Please don't hold back. I want to get stronger.

dialogue.speaker: hinata
dialogue.text: Thank you... I hit harder when I stopped being afraid of hurting you.

dialogue.speaker: hinata
dialogue.text: I'll keep getting stronger. Like... like Naruto does.
